verdict.rationale: Unit is a banking-as-a-service API platform for building financial products (accounts, cards, payments), not an AI-native tool with bulk-operation or batch-processing features; evidence describes account/card/payment infrastructure but nothing about performing bulk operations across many items for an AI-native user. No mention of batch APIs, bulk endpoints, or automation tooling for mass operations. Missing for 10: any evidence of batch/bulk API endpoints, bulk data operations, or automation tooling enabling operations across many items at once.
